summary: 2026 Ducati Lenovo Team (Marc Marquez, Francesco Bagnaia; Desmosedici GP, Rosso Centenario livery). Lenovo is title partner (front). From Ducati's own partner page (archived 12 Dec 2025): Audi, Monster Energy, Shell and TIM are Main Partners; Akrapovic, Elica, NetApp, Riello UPS and UnipolSai are Official Sponsors; Aruba, Autogrill, Bosch, Carrera, Contadi Castaldi, Daiko, Diadora, Eataly, Flex-Box, Givi, Melinda, Amaro Montenegro, Motorola, Parmacotto, Philip Morris International, Randstad and Vmoto are Official Partners; Beta, Brembo, Cobo, DID, Domino, Mahle, Marelli, NGK, Reflexallen, Siemens, Thermal Technology, Var Group and WD-40 are technical partners. Four slots on the page are presented without a company name (two Official Partners, two technical partners). Michelin is MotoGP's league-wide tyre supplier.
